nodes.label: 01 — Controlled Passage
nodes.rationale: Recommended route: separate inputs resolve through one deliberate opening into a clear route (complexity made actionable under human control). Strength: broad enough for every future product. Test: keep it from reading like a flowchart or a letter.

nodes.label: 02 — Human Checkpoint
nodes.rationale: A route changes direction at a distinct control point before continuing; consequential actions remain a human decision. Strength: expresses review and agency. Test: avoid resembling a generic routing/navigation icon.

nodes.label: 03 — Recoverable Change
nodes.rationale: Two states remain connected by a clear return path; builders can move forward with confidence and recover when needed. Strength: grounded in checkpoints and rollback. Test: avoid looking like a generic undo or infinity symbol.
